# couchbase-capella_app_service_maintenance_schedule (Resource)

Manages the queue time of an existing, Couchbase-initiated App Service maintenance. This resource does not create a maintenance: it adopts one listed by the `couchbase-capella_app_service_maintenances` data source and reschedules it to `queue_at`. Only `pending` maintenance can be rescheduled, to a time in the future and within its scheduling window.

Maintenance initiated by a self-service upgrade is managed with `couchbase-capella_app_service_self_service_upgrade` instead.

Destroying this resource only removes it from the Terraform state; the maintenance keeps its last queue time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "couchbase-capella_app_service_maintenance_schedule" "new_maintenance_schedule" {
  organization_id = "aaaaaa-bbbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
  project_id      = "aaaaaa-bbbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
  cluster_id      = "aaaaaa-bbbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
  app_service_id  = "aaaaaa-bbbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
  maintenance_id  = "<maintenance_id>"
  queue_at        = "2026-09-05T02:30:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_service_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the appService.
- `cluster_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the cluster.
- `maintenance_id` (String) - The ID of the App Service maintenance record, as listed by the `couchbase-capella_app_service_maintenances` data source.
- `organization_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the organization.
- `project_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the project.
- `queue_at` (String) - The RFC3339 timestamp at which the maintenance is queued to start. It must be in the future and within the maintenance scheduling window.

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Attributes) Couchbase audit data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `completed_at` (String) - The RFC3339 timestamp at which the maintenance completed. Null until it completes.
- `current_state` (String) - The current state of the maintenance, for example `pending`. Only `pending` maintenance can be rescheduled.
- `initiated_by` (String) - Who initiated the maintenance: `couchbase` or `selfService`.
- `kind` (String) - The kind of maintenance, for example `upgrade`.
- `version_id` (String) - The ID of the release the maintenance moves the App Service to. Null when no release contains the maintenance image.

<a id="nestedatt--audit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `audit`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) - The RFC3339 timestamp associated with when the resource was initially created.
 - **Format**: Date-time in RFC3339 format
- `created_by` (String) - The user who created the resource; this will be a UUID4 ID for standard users and will be a string such as "internal-support" for internal Couchbase support users.
- `modified_at` (String) - The RFC3339 timestamp associated with when the resource was last modified.
 - **Format**: Date-time in RFC3339 format
- `modified_by` (String) - The user who last modified the resource; this will be a UUID4 ID for standard users and will be a string such as "internal-support" for internal Couchbase support users.
- `version` (Number) - The version of the document. This value is incremented each time the resource is modified.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import couchbase-capella_app_service_maintenance_schedule.new_maintenance_schedule organization_id=<organization_id>,project_id=<project_id>,cluster_id=<cluster_id>,app_service_id=<app_service_id>,maintenance_id=<maintenance_id>
```
